product_path: Match product/manufacturer and exact CCMC number; retrieve the actual published assessment.

Compare project use with report limitations, permitted substrates/assemblies, load/climate/fire conditions, installation and quality-control requirements.
Extract the specific test standards/evidence and use them to request supporting documents; the registry row alone does not establish performance or acceptance.
Verify Alberta adoption/current article mappings separately; identify whether an acceptable-solution route exists or a project alternative solution is still required.
Carry the report and responsible professional into Section D evidence; leave performance judgment to the AHJ/professional.
